justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Return-to-driving rates and accident prevention outcomes documented; CDRS vs non-certified comparison absent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ADED CDRS requires significant experience plus exam; specialized vehicle access needed for practice.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable exclusively to driver rehabilitation and adaptive vehicle modification; very niche population.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: CDRS enables billing for driver evaluation and adaptive vehicle training; Medicare and some commercial cover; unique billing niche.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Consistent demand in driver rehabilitation centers and adaptive technology programs; very specialized.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Driving independence is highly valued; emotional significance is substantial.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Driving evaluations and adaptive driving training are largely cash-pay or paid by vocational rehab, with families willingly paying.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Evaluations commonly run $400-$800 and on-road training $150+/hr with little fee pressure.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Very few CDRS-certified clinicians per state; among the most differentiated rehab niches.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Adaptive driving programs scale modestly by adding instructors and adapted vehicles, though vehicle capital is heavy.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Older adults, TBI/stroke survivors, and disabled teens generate steady demand, but volume per market is limited.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires adapted vehicles, on-road training, and ADED credentialing; capital and time intensive.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Niche practice credential with minimal academic weight in PT/OT faculty hiring.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Small body of literature, mostly in OT journals and gerontology.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Tangential to most curricula; appears in OT community mobility content but minimally in PT.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence is mostly observational with limited RCTs given the practical challenges.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Essentially never listed in faculty job postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Pathway is slow and capital-heavy with little academic payoff.
